description: This file contains private definitions, includes, macros, and function declarations for the OVSDB (Open vSwitch Database) subsystem used in the OneWifi project. It primarily provides external function prototypes and macro definitions for internal use within the OVSDB module.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_jsonrpc_id_new
methods.description: Returns a new JSON-RPC ID for OVSDB operations.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_tran_comment
methods.description: Inserts a comment into an OVSDB transaction JSON array.

methods.name: onewifi_ovsdb_tran_operation
methods.description: Generates a JSON object representing a transaction operation.
